description: This file defines the TaxComponentData class, a data transfer object (DTO) used in the Apache Fineract project to represent tax component details, including account information and historical data.

classes.name: TaxComponentData
classes.description: An immutable data class representing tax component details, including account types, percentages, date ranges, and histories.

methods.name: instance
methods.description: Creates a new TaxComponentData instance with provided details and null options for account choices.

methods.name: lookup
methods.description: Creates a minimal TaxComponentData object with only ID and name, other fields null.

methods.name: template
methods.description: Creates a template TaxComponentData object with provided account options and null other fields.

methods.name: createTaxComponent
methods.description: Factory method to create a simple TaxComponentData with only ID, percentage, and account data.

methods.name: getApplicablePercentage
methods.description: Determines the applicable percentage based on a given date, considering historical changes.

methods.name: occursOnDayFrom
methods.description: Checks if a given date is after the start date to determine applicability.
